question.text: Regarding recent amendments to SEBI (AIF) Regulations related to migration and certification, which of the following is CORRECT?

answer.text: Funds registered as venture capital funds under SEBI (VCF) Regulations, 1996 must compulsorily liquidate by 2025; no migration path is available
NISM-XIX-C certification is optional for AIF key investment team members

Funds registered as VCFs under SEBI (VCF) Regulations, 1996 can seek migration to SEBI (AIF) Regulations as 'migrated venture capital fund' subject to 2/3 investor approval by value, within July 19, 2025; at least one key personnel of the Manager must hold NISM-XIX-C (or XIX-D for Cat I/II-only managers, or XIX-E for Cat III-only managers) certification — not applicable for AI-only Funds
NISM-XIX-C is required only for the Compliance Officer, not for investment team members

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular No.: SEBI/HO/AFD/SEC-3/P/CIR2025/85 dated June 6, 2025: VCF migration to AIF framework with 2/3 investor approval by value, by July 19, 2025. Per SEBI (AIF) (Amendment) Regulations, 2020: at least one key personnel of AIF Manager must hold NISM-XIX-C (or category-specific XIX-D/XIX-E). Per SEBI (AIF) (Third Amendment) Regulations, 2025 (w.e.f. Nov 19, 2025): this certification requirement is not applicable for AI-only Funds. The Trap: Options A/B/D misstate the migration path or certification scope. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C uniquely covers recent amendments (VCF migration, AI-only Funds, certification). XIX-D/E are the category-specific exams. Manager's Pro-Tip: Manager tip: Build an NISM-XIX-C renewal tracker — certifications expire; on expiry, the key person must recertify to maintain AIF Manager eligibility. Record initial certification date and maintain scanned certificate for SEBI inspection. For AI-only Funds, document the exemption rationale in the PPM.
